source_semantics.local_CHAMP: 200Hz wall timer; safe velocity becomes zero; generate(step_length==0) keeps fresh nominal feet, replaces previous feet and returns. Publisher uses one positions-only point at1/60s with header0.
source_semantics.JTC: New messages replace trajectories. On first sample default interpolate_from_desired_state=false captures measured state; header0 starts now. Effort-only PID includes velocity error. Controller reads previous effort command into its start state.
source_semantics.trajectory: Positions-only endpoints use linear interpolation, reference velocity=(goal-position_at_start)/duration. Empty final effort becomes zero; nonempty start effort is interpolated toward it.

causal_assessment: Confirmed: actual final safezero is followed by a198.56mrad target change; one measured-state JTC sample creates10.06rad/s reference velocity and14.66rad/s velocity error. Both position arrays match exactly at that sample.

Supported: configured derivative feedback and short interpolation produce an immediate effort transient, followed by measured joint velocity. This occurs without an instantaneous actual joint-position jump.

Not established: that transient uniquely explains slope drift/fall. Flat sequence completed, body contact0 and post-edge tilt small. Normal gait immediately before the edge already has high reference/actual velocity and effort.

The first turn-stop target change is only12.47mrad/4.66mm; the old surrounding-window maximum occurred before the safezero edge. Final forward-stop is198.56mrad/42.59mm. Stop phase strongly affects magnitude.

candidate_review.status: Proposal only; no implementation or causal A/B performed in this review.
candidate_review.preferred_minimal_scope: Demo-local joint trajectory relay, with CHAMP remapped to a raw target input and relay as the only JTC publisher. Nonzero safe-command gait messages preserve all original fields and cadence. Shared go2 sources and SLAM remain untouched.
candidate_review.stop_only: On an actual safe-command zero transition, settle joint posture toward the genuine CHAMP standing target with one bounded approximately150ms trajectory, then hold it. Suppress redundant identical zero trajectories so the same motion is not restarted every5ms. Do not send another locomotion Twist or continue gait phases after safety zero.
candidate_review.conditional_design: A positions-only150ms target reduces the same first-sample displacement-derived velocity about9fold. A measured-q/velocity start and zero-velocity endpoint can provide C1 continuity, but cubic overshoot with large initial velocity must be bounded against URDF limits and checked physically before adoption. Duration150ms is a candidate, not a certified stopping bound.
candidate_review.callback_race: safe_command and raw CHAMP targets are separate topics. The first target received after zero may be an old gait sample. Relay must inhibit old gait targets immediately and use a verified standing target, e.g. cached initial stable CHAMP standing vector in this fixed-body-pose Demo, or explicit target/mode synchronization. Do not blindly assume arrival order.
